SILEX ONTOLOGY SPECIFICATION V1.1

The SILEX ontology represents municipal services and procedures, their units, channels, legal bases, deadlines, statuses, and version relations. Version 1.1 is the basis for the initial mappings and will be superseded by version 1.2 after bilingual labels and constraints identified during validation are corrected.

Class and property identifiers are language independent. Spanish and English labels express the same concept and are reviewed together. An editorial change does not change the identifier; an incompatible semantic change requires a documented new version.

Version pattern

Every versioned resource may declare a previous version, next version, start of validity, and end of validity. Version relations must be reciprocal, must not form cycles, and remain within the same document language. Cross-language equivalence is expressed through a separate parallel relation.

silex:PublicService — Public service

Class for a provision organized by a public administration. It must not be translated as public procedure because one service may offer several procedures and channels.

Approved Spanish label: “Servicio público”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:AdministrativeProcedure — Administrative procedure

A regulated sequence of actions leading to a decision, registration, authorization, or notification. It is distinct from an individual application.

Approved Spanish label: “Procedimiento administrativo”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:Application — Application

A specific request submitted by a person or organization. Its status must not be confused with the general status of the procedure.

Approved Spanish label: “Solicitud”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:CompetentUnit — Competent unit

Administrative entity responsible for processing or deciding. It includes a stable code and a display name with a validity period.

Approved Spanish label: “Unidad competente”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:DeliveryChannel — Service delivery channel

Means through which information is obtained or an application is submitted: online, in person, telephone, post, or another authorized channel.

Approved Spanish label: “Canal de prestación”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:LegalBasis — Legal basis

Rule, call, or provision supporting the procedure. Superseded versions are retained with their validity period.

Approved Spanish label: “Base jurídica”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:ResolutionPeriod — Resolution period

Duration or deadline expressed technically and through a readable label. It must preserve whether days are working or calendar days.

Approved Spanish label: “Plazo de resolución”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:ProcedureStatus — Procedure status

General availability or validity status of a procedure. It does not represent the status of a particular application.

Approved Spanish label: “Estado del procedimiento”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:ApplicationStatus — Application status

Value within the history of an application: draft, submitted, under review, correction requested, resolved, withdrawn, or archived.

Approved Spanish label: “Estado de la solicitud”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

silex:FieldAssessment — Field assessment

Classification of a value as present, missing, non-applicable, excluded, or pending. It allows gaps to be interpreted correctly.

Approved Spanish label: “Evaluación de campo”. The class must include a definition, example, and provenance. Alternative labels support search but do not create a new entity.

Status vocabulary

The minimum application-status vocabulary contains draft, submitted, under review, correction requested, resolved, and archived. Withdrawn and cancelled are not equivalent: the former corresponds to an action by the applicant and the latter to an administrative or technical decision. History retains the date, agent, and reason for each change.

Constraints

Every procedure must have an identifier, a title in at least one language, a competent unit or an explicit field assessment, and provenance. Legal basis and channel are mandatory except for type-specific exceptions. Informational records may lack an application and resolution period without producing an error.

Normalized deadlines will use ISO 8601 durations where possible and retain a human-readable label. Internal codes and display names are stored separately. Cardinality rules must not turn a pending legal condition into an invented value.

Abbreviated example

Procedure SM-URB-014 is typed as AdministrativeProcedure, linked to the Urban Permits Unit through competentUnit, declares two deliveryChannel values, and retains a resolutionPeriod of one month. Its legal basis points to an identified version. A specific request under the procedure uses Application and its own ApplicationStatus history.
